Delivery and returns

Our books are sold through Amazon and other shops, which deliver your order and handle any returns.

Needs legal review before launch. This page is a template. Fill in everything in square brackets and have it checked before taking real orders. (This notice disappears when you untick "Needs legal review" in the admin.)

Delivery

We don't sell or post books from this website. When you buy one of our books, you buy it from Amazon or from the shop linked on the book page, and that shop delivers it to you. Postage costs and delivery times are shown by the shop before you pay.

Our paperbacks are printed to order, so allow a few extra days for printing when you order from Amazon.

Returns, refunds and damaged books

Contact the shop you bought from. For Amazon orders, use Your Orders in your Amazon account to return a book or report a problem. Your rights as a consumer, including under the Consumer Rights Act 2015, apply to your purchase from that shop.

eBooks

eBooks are sold through Amazon Kindle, and Amazon's Kindle return policy applies.

Problems with a book itself

If you find a printing fault or a mistake in one of our books, we'd like to know. Email us at info@outandaboutbooks.co.uk and tell us which book and where.

This page describes how buying works while the books are sold only through other shops. If you start selling books or merchandise yourself, this page must be replaced with a full delivery, cancellation and returns policy. Please have it reviewed before launch.
